0.0.n: Refers to this video or installment, rather than specifically today.

0.1.n: Marks 今回 as the topic, setting the scope for this presentation.

0.2.n: Describes the console as a newly designed model.

0.3.n: PS is the abbreviation used in the product name PS5.

0.4.n: Part of the product name PS5, identifying the console generation.

0.6.n: Part of the product name here, identifying the smaller console version.

0.7.n: Links the console name to 開封レビュー, showing which product is being unboxed and reviewed.

0.8.n: Combines with レビュー to describe a review featuring the opening of the product package.

0.9.n: An English loanword used here for an assessment of the product.

0.10.n: Marks the unboxing review as what the presenter will deliver.

0.11.n: The お prefix adds respectful modesty to 届け; together with します, it politely presents content to viewers.

0.12.n: Polite form of する; completes お届けします to announce what the presenter will provide.

1.0.n: 年 follows a number to indicate a calendar year.

1.1.n: Combines with 月 to name the eleventh month, November.

1.2.n: After 11, 月 identifies a calendar month rather than a duration.

1.3.n: Marks November 2023 as the time of the release.

1.4.n: Describes the PS5 Slim as a new version of the console.

1.5.n: PS is the abbreviation used in the product name PS5.

1.6.n: Part of the product name PS5, identifying the console generation.

1.8.n: Part of the product name here, identifying the smaller console version.

1.9.n: Marks the new PS5 Slim as the product that was released.

1.10.n: 発売する becomes 発売された, a past passive form showing the console received the action.

1.11.n: Connects the release to the speaker’s purchase as its reason.

1.13.n: Emphasizes acting promptly after the console became available.

1.14.n: The speaker refers to themself with a neutral, polite personal pronoun.

1.15.n: Adds the speaker to others who bought the console.

1.16.n: The て-form of 購入する connects buying the console to the following action.

1.17.n: 使う in て-form plus みる means trying an action; ました makes it polite and past.

2.0.n: Points back to the situation explained in the previous sentence.

2.1.n: Refers to the preceding explanation rather than introducing a new reason.

2.2.n: Completes そんなわけで, a linking phrase meaning that the previous explanation leads into what follows.

2.3.n: Refers to the current video or installment.

2.4.n: Marks 今回 as the topic of the upcoming invitation.

2.6.n: Modifies the console name to distinguish this version from earlier models.

2.7.n: PS is the abbreviation used in the product name PS5.

2.8.n: Part of the product name PS5, identifying the console generation.

2.10.n: Part of the product name here, identifying the smaller console version.

2.11.n: Pairs directly with レビュー to name the type of review.

2.12.n: An English loanword; the preceding words specify the product and review type.

2.13.n: Marks the unboxing review as the subject to be explored.

2.14.n: 見る in て-form plus いく suggests proceeding through the content; ましょう politely invites viewers along.

0.lit: This time, the new-model PS5 Slim’s unboxing review, we will bring you.
0.tip: お届けします is a polite, modest way to announce content being presented to viewers.

1.lit: Because the new-model PS5 Slim was released in November 2023, promptly I too bought it and tried using it.
1.tip: A verb’s て-form followed by みる means trying the action, not seeing it.

2.lit: For that reason, this time, about the new-model PS5 Slim unboxing review, let’s proceed to look.
2.tip: 見ていきましょう invites viewers to explore the content together as the video proceeds.
